verses.text: Ha in ix in ochpax yet' winhaj Darío sreyal Media t'a b'ab'el ab'il yoch winh reyal chi', xchi.

Ix yalanxi t'ayin: Ha tikne'ik, ol wak' ojtakejel tas t'inhan ol ujok. Ayto och oxwanh heb' winh rey t'a Persia, slajwi chi' ol och junxo winh schanhil rey. Ha jun winh chi', más te b'eyum winh t'a yichanh heb' oxwanh chi'. Ha yuj sb'eyumal winh chi', ol yik' yip winh, ol yak'an wal owal winh yet' winh sreyal Grecia.
Slajwi chi', ol och jun winh sreyal Grecia chi', te ak'um owal. Ol te lewanb'ok smakb'en chi', ol sk'ulan masanil tas snib'ej.

Palta ayik toxo ix yik' yip yopisio winh chi', chanhpoj ol ajkanb'atok. Ha yopisio jun winh rey chi', manh ol b'eynhejb'at t'a heb' yinhtilal. Ol el yip yopisio winh chi', manhxo lajanok ol aj yip icha t'a sb'ab'elal, yujto chanhpoj ol ajok, ch'okxo pax mach ol ochkan reyal sk'exulok winh.

Ha jun winh ol ochkan sreyalok sur, ol ste ik'ej yip winh, palta a junokxo winh yajal soldado te niwan ol aj yopisio t'a yichanh jun winh sreyal sur chi', ol yak'an yajalil winh t'a jun makb'en te lewan chi'.

Haxo yik ol ek' jaye'ok ab'il, a heb' winh chawanh rey chi', ol sb'o junok strato heb' winh. Ha jun winh sreyal sur chi', ol yak'b'at junok yisil winh t'a winh sreyal norte, yik wach' ay junk'olal t'a skal chab' makb'en chi'. Palta manh ol yal yuj ix yik'an b'ey jun trato yet' winh yetb'eyum chi'. Yuj chi' ol miljokcham ix yet' winh yet' yune' ix yet' pax heb' schekab' ix.
Palta ay junok sk'ab' yok ix ol och reyal, ol yak'an owal yet' heb' soldado yik norte. Ol ak'jok ganar heb' yuj yet' chonhab' b'aj kajan jun winh sreyal norte chi'.

Ol yik'b'at sdiosal heb' ay t'a norte chi' t'a Egipto, haton juntzanh b'ob'il t'a k'e'en k'e'en yet' juntzanh syamk'ab' heb' nab'a oro yet' plata. Ol ek'b'at jaye'ok ab'il, malaj owal ol och t'a skal heb'.
Ol lajwok chi', a jun winh sreyal norte chi', ol yak' owal winh yet' jun winh sreyal sur chi', palta manh ol yal-laj yuj winh, ol meltzaj winh t'a schonhab'.

Palta haxo heb' yuninal winh sreyal norte chi', ol k'e wa'an heb' yak' owal. Manh jantakok sb'isul soldado heb' ol smolb'ej. Ha junok heb' yuninal winh chi' ol b'at yet' heb' soldado yak' owal yet' winh sreyal sur chi' yik syak'an ganar yalani. Ol ek'b'at heb' icha junok eluma', masanto ol k'och heb' t'a schonhab' winh sreyal sur chi'.
Yuj chi' ol te kot yowal winh sreyal sur chi'. Ol elta winh yak' owal t'a jun nhilanh soldado ajk'ol chi', ol satjokel heb' smasanil yuj winh.
Yujto ol satel jun nhilanh heb' ajk'ol chi' yuj winh, ol yik'ancha'anh sb'a winh, tzijtumto juntzanhxo heb' ajk'o'ol ol smilcham winh, palta manh niwanok tiempo ol yak' yopisio winh chi'.

Ayik ol ek'b'at jaye'ok ab'il, a winh sreyal norte chi', te ek'b'al niwan heb' soldado ol smolb'ej winh t'a yichanh heb' ix smolb'ej t'a sb'ab'elal, ol b'atxok winh yak' owal yet' winh sreyal sur chi', yet'nak syamk'ab' heb' yik owal smasanil.

Ha t'a jun pekti' chi', tzijtum heb' ol och ajk'olal t'a winh sreyal sur chi'. Ha t'a skal heb' chi', ay juntzanh heb' etisraelal te chuk spensar, ol spak sb'a heb' yik tz'elk'och tas ak'b'il yil heb' sna'ani, palta manh ol yak'laj ganar heb'.

Ol jawok winh sreyal norte chi', ol och hoyan soldado t'a spatiktak jun chonhab' te tek'an, ol ak'jok ganar jun chonhab' chi' yuj heb'. Ha heb' soldado te jelan yik sur, manh ol yal-laj stek'b'an sb'a heb' t'a yichanh winh ajk'ol chi'.

Ha winh ol ak'an ganar chi', ol sk'ulejnhej winh tas snib'ej t'a jun winh ol ak'jok ganar chi'. Manhxalaj mach ol yal stek'b'an sb'a t'a yichanh winh. Ol kan winh t'a sat lum lum te wach', haton Israel, ol satanel winh jantaknhej tas snib'ej.

Ol yak' yip winh yet' heb' soldado yik'anek' slum winh sreyal sur chi'. Ol yak'an jun strato winh yet' winh rey chi', ol yak'anb'at junok yisil winh yetb'eyumok jun winh rey chi', yik syak'an ganar winh yalani, palta manh ol elk'ochlaj icha tas sna winh chi'.

Ol lajwok chi', ol yak'an owal winh yet' juntzanh chonhab' ay t'a stitak ha' mar. Tzijtum heb' ol ak'jok ganar yuj winh, palta ay jun yajal soldado ol kachan wanaj winh, icha chi' ol aj yel sk'ixwelal winh sreyal norte chi'.
Ol lajwok chi', ol meltzaj winh t'a smakb'en b'aj ay juntzanh schonhab', te ay yip, palta ol ak'jok ganar, ol satelok.

Ch'okxo junxo winh rey ol ochkan sk'exulok winh, a jun winh chi', ol schekb'at junok mach winh, b'at sk'ananel tumin syak' heb' t'a winh, yik sk'ek'och winh yet' yopisio chi' sna'ani. Palta jayeanto k'uhal yoch winh t'a yopisio chi', ol miljokcham winh, manhok t'a skal owal ol cham winh.

Ol lajwok chi', ay jun winh te malaj yelk'och ol och reyal sk'exulok winh. Ha jun winh chi', manh smojok yoch winh t'a yopisio. Manh na'anok yuj heb' anima ayik ol och winh reyal chi' yuj yak'an musansatil heb' anima chi'.
Masanil heb' ajk'ol yajoch t'a winh, ol satel heb' yuj winh, ol satpaxel winh sat sacerdote yik Dios.
Ol ak'jokpax musansatil heb' yuj winh, haton heb' ol yak'lej sb'o'an strato yet' winh t'a wach'ilal. Wach'chom kennhej anima ayoch yet' winh, palta ol yak'nhej ganar winh.

Ayik manh na'anok yuj heb' anima chi', ol och winh t'a sat slu'um heb', haton lum te wach'. Ol sk'ulejnhej winh tastak to maj sk'ulej heb' smam yicham. Masanil tas ol yik' winh t'a owal chi', ol spojek' winh t'a skal heb' ajun yet'ok. Ol snib'ej winh yak' owal yet' juntzanh chonhab' to tek'an, palta manh niwanok tiempo ol yal yuj winh.

Ol yak'och sjelanil winh chi' yipok sk'o'ol, ol yak'an owal winh yet' winh sreyal sur. Niwan sb'isul soldado ol och yet' winh, palta a winh sreyal sur chi' yet' wal yip yet' pax soldado te jelan ol yak'an owal yet' winh. Palta manh ol yal-laj stek'b'an sb'a heb' soldado chi', yujto tonhej ol ak'jok musansatil winh sreyal sur chi'.
Ha heb' yetyajalil winh sreyal sur chi' awtab'il wa'el yuj t'a smexa, ipan heb' ol meltzajoch ajk'olal t'ay. Ol lajwokel heb' soldado chi', tzijtum heb' ol chamok.

Ha tas nab'il yuj chawanh heb' winh rey chi', anhej yak'an chukal heb' t'ay junjun. Ol mol em k'ojan heb' wa'el t'a smexa. Ol yak'an es heb' t'ay junjun, palta malaj junok heb' ol elk'och tas snib'ej, yujto manto k'och sk'uhal alb'ilkan yuj Dios.

Haxo winh sreyal norte chi', ol meltzajxok winh t'a schonhab' yet' masanil tas ol yik' winh t'a owal chi'. Ol lajwok chi', ol och winh ajk'olal t'a ejmelal syak' heb' israel, haton jun strato Dios sb'onak yet' heb', haxo sk'ulan winh masanil tas nab'il yuj chi'. Ol lajwok chi', ol meltzaj winh t'a smakb'en.
Ayik ol k'och stiempo'al nab'il yuj Dios, ol b'atxok winh yet' heb' soldado yak' owal t'a sur. Palta ha t'a junelxo chi', manhxo ol yak'laj ganar winh icha t'a sb'ab'elal.

Yujto a heb' soldado t'a stojolal b'aj tz'em k'u, ol jawok heb' t'a yol barco. Ha heb' chi' ol kachanoch wa'an winh. Icha chi' ol aj xiw winh sreyal norte chi', haxo smeltzaj winh chi' t'a spatik. Yuj chi', haxo t'a yib'anh strato Dios yet' heb' israel ol smak'el yowal sk'ol winh. Ol scha'an winh yab' tas ol yal heb' aktannakkan jun trato chi'.

Haxo heb' soldado chi', ol yixtejb'at stemplo Dios heb' yet' cuartel junnhej yaj yet'ok. Ol syamoch wa'an heb' yak'chaj silab' t'a junjun k'u. Haxo tas yajb'ilel yuj Dios, a ol yak'och heb' t'a yol templo chi' yik syixtanel heb'.
Ol smontej heb' etisraelal jun winh rey chi', haton heb' toxo ix aktankan strato Dios. Haxo pax heb' chonhab' xajanan sDiosal, ol stek'b'ej sb'a heb' t'a yichanh tas ol ujok chi'.

Ay heb' jelan t'a skal heb' etchonhab' ol k'ayb'an tzijtumok heb' etchonhab' chi', palta ay heb' ol miljokchamok, ay heb' ol nhusjoktz'aok, ay heb' ol elk'ajb'at tastak ay t'ay, ay pax heb' ol ik'jokb'at chekab'il.
Ayik ol k'och stiempo'al spechchaj b'eyek' heb', malaj wal mach ol kolwaj t'a heb'. Tzijtum mach junnhej ol yutej sb'a yet' heb', palta chab'sat juntzanh heb' chi'.

Ol miljokcham jaywanhok heb' k'ayb'um jelan t'a skal a chonhab' chi', yik wach' ol ak'chaj prowal juntzanhxo heb' olto kanok, yik wach' tz'ik'chajel heb' chab'sat chi' t'a skal heb', haxo stojolb'i spensar heb' chi', masanto ol k'och slajwub' tiempo'al nab'il yuj Dios.

Ha winh sreyal norte chi', ol sk'ulej winh icha tas snib'ej, ichaton chi' ol aj yik'ancha'anh sb'a winh, ol yalan winh to niwan yelk'och winh t'a yichanh komon Dios. Ol yal b'uchwal lolonel winh t'a Dios te yel. Ol sk'ulejnhej masanil tas ol snib'ej winh masanto ol jawok yowal sk'ol Dios t'a yib'anh winh, yujto a tas nab'il yuj Dios chi', ol elk'ochok.

Ha jun winh rey chi', malaj yelk'och sdiosal heb' smam yicham winh t'ay. Malaj pax yelk'och tas nib'ab'il yuj heb' ix ix t'a yol sat winh yet' pax komon Dios, yujto a jun winh chi', ol yal winh to ek'b'al niwan yelk'och winh t'a yichanh masanil juntzanh chi'.

Palta ch'ok jun Dios b'aj ol och winh ejmelal, haton t'a jun Dios b'aj manh yak'nakokem sb'a heb' smam yicham winh, haton jun Dios stanhwan chonhab' to tek'an. Ol yak'an silab' winh t'ay, haton k'e'en oro, k'e'en plata, k'e'en k'e'en te wach' yilji yet' juntzanhxo tastak to te caro stojol.

Ha yuj skolwal jun ch'ok diosal chi', ol yak' ganar juntzanh chonhab' te ay yip winh. Ha heb' ol yak'och sb'a t'a yol sk'ab' jun winh rey chi', ol ak'jokoch heb' t'a juntzanh niwak opisio yuj winh, ol ak'chaj lum lum stojolok heb'.

Ayik ol k'och slajwub' tiempo'al chi', a winh sreyal sur, ol yak' owal winh yet' jun winh sreyal norte chi'. Palta ol elta winh sreyal norte chi' yak' owal yet' winh yet' wal smasanil yipal. Ol elta winh yet' scarruaje yik owal yet' heb' soldado ayk'e t'a yib'anh chej. Tzijtum pax barco ol kot yet' winh. Tzijtum nación ol yak' ganar winh, yujto icha sb'ey ha' eluma' sb'ey heb' soldado winh.
Ol ochpax winh t'a lum lum te wach'. Tzijtum nación ol yak' ganar winh. Haxo pax heb' kajan t'a Edom yet' t'a Moab ol kolchajkanel heb', ek'b'alto pax nanhal heb' aj Amón ol kolchajok.
Ol yik'paxek' juntzanhxo nación winh, manhxo ol techajpax skolan sb'a Egipto t'a winh.
Ol ik'chajb'at masanil sb'eyumal Egipto chi', icha k'e'en oro, k'e'en plata yet' juntzanhxo tas wach'. Ol kanpax heb' aj Libia yet' heb' aj Etiopía t'a yol sk'ab' winh.

Palta ol jawok yab'ixal heb' kajan t'a stojolal b'aj sjawi k'u yet' t'a norte t'a winh, ol och winh t'a xiwk'olal yuj. Yuj chi' ol elta winh yet' yowal sk'o'ol, te niwan anima ol sna' winh smilchamok.
Ol sb'oank'e scampamento winh t'a skal ha' mar yet' jun tzalan b'aj ay stemplo Dios, haton ta' ol k'och stiempo'al satel winh, manhxa junok mach ol kolan winh.
